mentions.name: tray
mentions.description: A CLI-first inventory management tool for electronic engineering (EE) parts. It runs fully locally, is hobbyist friendly, and works well with agentic workflows since it is just a CLI.
mentions.audience: Hobbyists working with electronic parts, with a design that suits agentic (AI agent) workflows via the CLI.
mentions.source_excerpt:
CLI-first inventory management for EE parts. https://willwillems.github.io/tray

Fully local, hobbyist friendly, agentic workflows work great with it since it’s just a CLI.
